title: Microsoft Entra Users, Groups and Licenses

header.html: Create users and groups; manage user and group properties; manage licenses in Microsoft Entra ID; manage external users; configure self-service password reset (SSPR)
the official Microsoft Learn AZ-104 study guide, skills measured as of October 26, 2023

html:
1Users and groups

Microsoft Entra ID is Microsoft's cloud identity service. A tenant is a dedicated instance of it for an organization.

Object What to know
Member user A work account in your tenant
Guest user An external person invited into your tenant (B2B collaboration)
Group, type Security Used to manage access to resources and apps
Group, type Microsoft 365 A collaboration group (shared mailbox, calendar, Teams)
Assigned membership You add members
Dynamic membership Rules add and remove members automatically (needs Microsoft Entra ID P1 or higher)

You can create users one at a time, in bulk with a CSV file in the portal, or with PowerShell or the CLI. Deleted users stay recoverable for 30 days. User and group properties (job title, department, usage location, manager) can be edited, and dynamic groups use properties such as department in their rules.

Exam tip

. "Add users to a group automatically based on department" = a dynamic group. It requires P1 or higher.

2Licenses

Licenses (for example Microsoft 365 or Entra ID P1/P2) are assigned to users or groups.

Topic Fact
Usage location A user must have a usage location before a license can be assigned
Group-based licensing Assign a license to a group; all members get it; new members get it automatically
Errors Not enough licenses or conflicting service plans show as license assignment errors
Exam tip

. "License assignment fails for a user" = check the usage location and the available licenses.

3External users

Topic Fact
Invite Invite a guest by email; they accept the invitation
Guest access Guests get limited default permissions; control them with external collaboration settings
Use Give guests access with groups and RBAC roles, like members

4Self-service password reset (SSPR)

SSPR lets users reset their own passwords without calling the help desk.

Setting Meaning
Scope Enable for all users, a selected group, or none
Authentication methods The user proves identity with the number of methods required (1 or 2): phone, email, authenticator app, security questions
Registration Users register their methods; can be required at sign-in
Password writeback Sends the new password back to on-premises Active Directory in a hybrid setup (needs a paid license and Entra Connect)

Exam tip

. "Hybrid users reset passwords in the cloud and it must reach on-premises AD" = enable password writeback.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1An administrator wants users in the Sales department to join a group automatically. What should be used?

  • AAn assigned group updated manually every week
  • BA Microsoft 365 mailbox
  • CA guest account
  • DA dynamic membership group
Show the answer

Answer: D. Dynamic groups use rules on user properties (Entra ID P1 or higher).

S2A license cannot be assigned to a new user. What is a likely missing setting?

  • AThe user's profile photo
  • BThe group owner
  • CThe guest invitation
  • DThe usage location
Show the answer

Answer: D. A usage location is required before assigning a license.

S3A company wants all members of the Finance group to receive a Microsoft 365 license automatically, including new members. What should be configured?

  • AGroup-based licensing
  • BIndividual license assignment for each user
  • CA guest invitation
  • DA resource lock
Show the answer

Answer: A. Group-based licensing assigns licenses to all members, including new ones.

S4A partner employee needs access to one application. What is the best way to give them an identity?

  • AInvite them as a guest user
  • BCreate a member account and share the password
  • CShare an administrator account
  • DDisable authentication
Show the answer

Answer: A. Guest users are the B2B collaboration identity for external people.

S5Hybrid users reset their passwords in the cloud, but the new password must work on-premises. What should be enabled?

  • APassword writeback
  • BDynamic groups
  • CA management group
  • DA resource lock
Show the answer

Answer: A. Password writeback sends the new password to on-premises AD.

S6Which SSPR setting decides how many proofs of identity a user must give?

  • AThe tenant name that is shown on the sign-in page
  • BThe usage location that is assigned to the user
  • CThe number of authentication methods required
  • DThe group type that contains the user's account
Show the answer

Answer: C. The administrator sets the number of methods required.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is a guest user?

Show the answer

An external person invited into your tenant.

R2Which license level do dynamic groups need?

Show the answer

Microsoft Entra ID P1 or higher.

R3What must a user have before a license is assigned?

Show the answer

A usage location.

R4For how long can a deleted user be restored?

Show the answer

30 days.

R5What does SSPR stand for?

Show the answer

Self-service password reset.

R6What does password writeback do?

Show the answer

Sends a cloud password reset to on-premises Active Directory.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Users member vs guest; bulk create by CSV; deleted users recoverable 30 days
Groups security vs Microsoft 365; assigned vs dynamic (P1+)
Licenses usage location needed; group-based licensing
External users invite guests, control with collaboration settings
SSPR scope, methods required, registration, password writeback
